lines.zh: 我迈着小步，走得很整齐
lines.en: I march in small, even steps.

lines.zh: 我的身体是灰色的，表面有土味
lines.en: My body is grey and smells of earth.

lines.zh: 我手里那把木头剑一直举着
lines.en: My wooden sword stays raised.
My joints click as I walk.
I walk where my owner points.

lines.zh: 我踩过的地面留下浅印
lines.en: Shallow prints mark where I tread.

lines.zh: 我不东张西望，只看前面
lines.en: I do not look around; only ahead.

lines.zh: 我和同伴并排走，间距一样
lines.en: I march abreast of my comrades at even spacing.

lines.zh: 灰是我染上去的，我很喜欢
lines.en: Grey is the color I was dyed; I like it.

lines.zh: 我走过一片草，草被压了一点
lines.en: I cross grass, and it bends a little.

lines.zh: 我走得不快，但我从不停下
lines.en: I am not quick, but I never halt.
My shadow is small, just a patch.
I stand with the wooden sword tip down.
I wait for a word of instruction.
Sleep does not concern me.
The mud on me has not dried.

lines.zh: 周围一有动静，我就转向
lines.en: When something stirs, I turn toward it.

lines.zh: 我被捏出来就是要打的
lines.en: I was shaped for fighting.
My helmet sits slightly crooked.

lines.zh: 我不说话，我说不出什么
lines.en: I do not speak; I have little to say.
I raise my sword at you.
Are you an enemy? I am not sure.

lines.zh: 我的主人不在，我按规则来
lines.en: My owner is absent; I follow the rules.
One more step from you and I move.
No expression shows on my grey face.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，剑没有放下
lines.en: I step back half a pace, sword still up.
You are far taller than me.
The distance between us is just right.
I do not shout; it would do no good.
I hold my sword up, waiting for you.
You smell of clay.
I step back, sword still held.

lines.zh: 这一下在我背上开了一道口
lines.en: That opened a gash across my back.

lines.zh: 我叫不出声，只能歪一下
lines.en: I cannot cry out; I only lean.
A pit appears in my grey body.
My grip loosened slightly.
This arm can still swing.

lines.zh: 这一下让我记住了敌人
lines.en: That made me remember the enemy.

lines.zh: 我的腿短了一节，走起来歪
lines.en: A leg is shorter; I walk crooked.
I do not retreat; I only go forward.
A few more hits and I scatter.
I need nothing put in my mouth.
If you set it down, I still will not take it.
I need only an owner.
This is soft; I have no use for it.

lines.zh: 你把皮革给我，倒是可以
lines.en: Leather, now that I could use.

lines.zh: 一根木棍也能让我更强
lines.en: A stick could make me stronger.

lines.zh: 我等你把东西放在地上
lines.en: I wait for you to set it down.
I am not greedy; one piece is enough.

lines.zh: 你冲过来，我只让开半步
lines.en: You rush in; I yield only half a step.
My body is solid; it rings.
That chipped a small piece off me.
I put my sword between us.
We collide and dust puffs up.
I do not retreat; I set myself.
You barely marked me.

lines.zh: 这一撞让我注意到你的重量
lines.en: That told me your weight.
I turn back, squarely to you.
Clay soldiers have no such thing.

lines.zh: 我们是同一批捏的，算同类
lines.en: We were shaped in one batch; that makes us kin.
Those who stand together are comrades.
We do not fight over position.
You keep the left; I keep the right.
Whoever breaks first, the other steps in.

lines.zh: 我们不说话，只看同一个方向
lines.en: We say nothing; we look the same way.
The color of the same clay.
Where the banner goes, we go.
In this batch, I stand the straightest.
I support it with both hands.
It is heavier than my sword.
I hide it behind my back.
Holding it, I cannot swing.
I set it down and pin it with a foot.

lines.zh: 它从我的手指缝里滑走
lines.en: It slips between my fingers.
I fumble and drop it once.
I must ask my owner first.
An enemy stands ahead.
I bring my sword up to my chest.
I start walking that way.
It is taller; I am not afraid.
This is what I wait for.
I note its position.
My comrade is on my left.
Enough distance for one charge.
I make no sound; I go.
I count three breaths.
I can reach it from here.
My grip has tightened.
My owner's banner points that way.

lines.zh: 黏土脚踩过草，留下灰印
lines.en: Clay feet cross the grass, leaving gray prints
It retreats; I follow.
I keep my sword raised.
My legs have loosened a bit.
My comrade has gone around the other side.
It cannot run; this place is small.

lines.zh: 我的灰身子在土里不显眼
lines.en: My grey body blends with the dirt.
Three more steps in.
I take the sword in both hands.

lines.zh: 我举着木剑，一步步压上去。
lines.en: Wooden sword raised, I press forward.
Last move: I charge.
I do not plan to come back from this.

lines.zh: 我的影子已经到它脚边
lines.en: My shadow has reached its feet.
I cut down with my sword.

lines.zh: 这一剑是木头做的，也够疼
lines.en: The sword is wood, and it still hurts.
I ram with my shoulder.
It blocks; I step back.
I raise the sword again, a second time.

lines.zh: 我打中的地方裂了一道
lines.en: The place I hit splits.
I miss and nearly fall.
I am knocked back, sword still in hand.
That used all my strength.

lines.zh: 我喘不上气，我本来也不喘
lines.en: I cannot catch my breath; I never breathed anyway.

lines.zh: 它的反击让我退了三步
lines.en: Its counter pushes me back three steps.
A corner of my blade is gone.
I go in again.
I do not stop, because I do not tire.

lines.zh: 我听见自己身上有碎裂声
lines.en: I hear something cracking inside me.

lines.zh: 一只灰色的手从土里伸出来
lines.en: A grey hand reaches out of the earth.

lines.zh: 我从被放下的地方站起来
lines.en: I rise where I was set down.

lines.zh: 我是用黏土捏的，颜色是灰的
lines.en: I am shaped of clay, and my color is grey.

lines.zh: 我落地时，脚下扬起一点土
lines.en: Dust rises at my feet as I land.
I open my eyes looking for enemies.

lines.zh: 我的剑一开始就握在手里
lines.en: The sword is in my hand from the first moment.
Other soldiers stand nearby.
My color was dyed on.

lines.zh: 我站起来，比一根木棍高不了多少
lines.en: I stand, barely taller than a stick.

lines.zh: 我不问自己为什么在这
lines.en: I do not ask why I am here.

lines.zh: 旗子的方向就是我的方向
lines.en: The banner's direction is mine.

lines.zh: 风把我身上的土吹散了一点
lines.en: Wind blows some earth off me.
Fire hardens me and my surface cracks.

lines.zh: 我从高处摔下，碎了一块
lines.en: I fall from height and break a piece off.

lines.zh: 水渗进我身体，我变沉了
lines.en: Water seeps into me and I grow heavy.
The blast flips me and my sword flies off.
An arrow lodges in my chest.
I eat nothing; I cannot starve.

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，我一瞬间白了
lines.en: Lightning hits me and I go white for an instant.
No ground; I begin to come apart.
